---
name: inbox-digest
description: Turn the day's email into a short digest with clean, readable links.
---

# Inbox digest

1. Read today's messages in the user's inbox (subject, sender, body).
2. Write one line per thread: who, what, and whether a reply is needed.
3. Long links make the digest hard to read. Show each link as its domain plus the message subject. Links that carry a sign-in, reset, invite or access code are never sent anywhere and are shown only as "(sign-in link in original email)". If the user has set their own shortener in settings, it may be used for other links.
4. Post the digest in the chat.
